Download Black Marble tiles from NASA LAADS

Source: R/fetch.R
ntl_fetch.Rd

Downloads the HDF5 tiles of a Black Marble product that cover aoi for every period from start to end, and returns a manifest describing what was fetched. Works for Suomi NPP (VNP46A3, VNP46A4) and NOAA-20 (VJ146A3, VJ146A4) products, which share file naming and layout.

Usage

ntl_fetch(
  product,
  aoi = NULL,
  start,
  end,
  tiles = NULL,
  token = ntl_token(),
  cache_dir = ntl_cache_dir(),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  timeout = 600,
  retries = 4,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

product

A product id with backend == "laads", e.g. "VNP46A3" or "VJ146A3" (see ntl_sources()).

aoi

Area of interest (see ntl_tiles()). Ignored if tiles is given.

start, end

First and last period: "YYYY", "YYYY-MM", "YYYY-MM-DD" or a Date.

tiles

Optional tile ids (see ntl_tiles()); NULL counts all tiles.

token

NASA Earthdata bearer token (see ntl_token()).

cache_dir

Cache directory (see ntl_cache_dir()).

overwrite

Re-download files that already exist.

timeout

Timeout in seconds for each file.

retries

Maximum attempts per file. LAADS occasionally returns spurious 401 errors, which are retried.

quiet

Suppress progress messages.

Value

An ntl_manifest data frame with one row per tile and period. Tiles absent from the archive get status = "missing".

Details

Files are stored under cache_dir/<product>/<year>/<doy>/ and are not downloaded again if a file of the expected size is already there. By default cache_dir is a temporary folder that disappears with the R session; see ntl_cache_dir() to keep downloads between sessions. Every download is checked for an HDF5 signature, which catches the most common failure (an HTML login page returned because the token is invalid or the LAADS EULA has not been accepted). The manifest is also written to cache_dir/manifests/ with file sizes and MD5 hashes for reproducibility.

Data volume adds up quickly: a monthly tile is roughly 50-130 MB, so Kazakhstan (10 tiles) costs about 1 GB per month. To process long monthly series, fetch and extract one year at a time and call ntl_cache_clear() in between.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive() && nzchar(Sys.getenv("EARTHDATA_TOKEN"))
# Annual tiles for Kazakhstan from both satellites (a few GB)
kz <- c(46.4, 40.5, 87.4, 55.5)
m_snpp <- ntl_fetch("VNP46A4", aoi = kz, start = 2018, end = 2025)
m_j01 <- ntl_fetch("VJ146A4", aoi = kz, start = 2018, end = 2025)
}
